attributes.additional_details: Current scenarios shows - majority of the unemployed are receiving or claimed Universal credit and due to immense pressure on such individuals they are allowed to take courses that could promote employment opportunities or search for work and start working some people do have health issues and some experienced ptsd or other mental issues returning back to work since pandemic the figures of such individuals have significantly risen and we need access to our private pensions regardless of our age.
attributes.background: Full access to private pensions scheme following cost of living in the past during pandemic, numbers of commercial sectors shut for business unemployment did increase and remained prevalent till today's date many have contributed into their private pension scheme of which should be granted.

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action.
 
We're not sure exactly what you mean by “full access to private pensions” and the circumstances in which you would like private pension access to be given or not.
